column1: # Test instances, one lock each (tools/device-lock.sh, LOCK_NAME=<name>). A dev/QA pair is given one android
# and/or one desktop instance when it is spawned, so pairs never wait on each other's locks. A new instance
# needs a row here, its own MCP server in .mcp.json (same launcher, its own env) and that server in
# settings.local.json's enabledMcpjsonServers. Only a server restart reserves every instance.
